english.note: Choose this when bestowing something specifically as a gift.
Use this as the everyday choice when presenting an ordinary gift to someone, rather than an award or official honour.

examples.english: This gift is something I bestow on you.
examples.traditional: 呢份禮物係我送畀你嘅。
examples.jyutping: nei1 fan6 lai5 mat6 hai6 ngo5 sung3 bei2 nei5 ge3

examples.english: I present you with a birthday gift.
examples.traditional: 我送畀你一份生日禮物。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sung3 bei2 nei5 jat1 fan6 saang1 jat6 lai5 mat6
